retrievalProfile.description: Creates a 1990s urban music aesthetic featuring a low-angle full-body portrait against a dramatic sky with vertically stacked, wide-tracked sans-serif typography.
triggerTerms: low angle urban portrait with vertical text
baggy jeans and white shirt fashion photography

recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, full-body shot of a male figure in baggy urban attire standing against a bright blue sky with white clouds, framed by dark graphic shapes and gold-toned vertical typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Low-angle perspective emphasizing the subject's height and dominance
Contrast between the bright sky and dark, silhouetted foreground elements
Vertical text alignment balancing the central verticality of the subject
Gold-toned typography against a blue and black background
coreInvariants: Low-angle camera perspective looking up at the subject
Vertical text orientation on the right margin
High-contrast lighting with deep shadows in the clothing

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central, full-body figure occupying the vertical center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's dark, baggy trousers and the vertical text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, moves down the body to the base, then travels up the vertical text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space provided by the sky and the dark graphic block in the upper left.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sky blue and cloud white providing a bright background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and dark navy in the clothing and graphic overlays.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted gold or bronze for the typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white shirt/sky and the black pants/graphic blocks.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Extreme letter spacing (tracking) for vertical stacking
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A secondary serif font used as a background watermark or logo element behind the primary sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Solid black square container for secondary branding

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, sturdy feel of 90s R&B branding
Provides the geometric, wide-set look common in the era

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A low-angle full-body photograph of a man in a white button-down shirt and very baggy black jeans, arms raised, standing against a bright blue sky with fluffy white clouds. A dark graphic shape occupies the top left corner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase geometric sans-serif text in gold, stacked vertically on the right side with extreme letter spacing. Add a secondary logo in the top left black square using a mix of serif and sans-serif fonts.

verificationChecks: Is the camera angle sufficiently low?
Is the text on the right stacked vertically with one letter per line?
Is the color palette limited to blue, white, black, and gold?
Are the jeans appropriately baggy for a 90s aesthetic?

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is vertically oriented on the right.
Ensure the subject is viewed from a low angle.
Verify the gold color of the typography.
Confirm the presence of the dark graphic block in the corner.
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-angle urban portrait + vertical gold sans-serif + high-contrast sky background = 90s R&B aesthetic.
